caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, Victorian-style dress set against a plain, light beige background. The dress is white or off-white in color, with decorative lavender or light purple accents. It has a fitted bodice featuring a V-shaped neckline and a row of buttons down the center, along with short sleeves ending just above the elbow, each trimmed with ruffles and purple detail. The skirt is voluminous and floor-length, extending outwards both in the front and the back, including a trailing train. The skirt is adorned with multiple horizontal bands of purple, and rows of purple teardrop-shaped decorations, as well as additional ruffles near the hem and down the center of the bodice. The dress is presented as if worn on an invisible mannequin, with no head, hands, or feet visible.
title: Dress
